title: Tiny, cute scooter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#1a3344'/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='78' r='12' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='78' r='9' fill='#4a4a4a'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='78' r='4' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='78' r='12' fill='#2a2a2a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='78' r='9' fill='#4a4a4a'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='78' r='4' fill='#ffdd55'/>

  <!-- Wheel highlights -->
  <circle cx='21' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#aaaaaa'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='74' r='2.5' fill='#aaaaaa'/>

  <!-- Deck / footboard -->
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='56' height='8' rx='4' fill='#ff6b6b'/>
  <rect x='22' y='68' width='56' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff9999'/>

  <!-- Body / frame connecting to front -->
  <path d='M 50 68 L 62 68 L 62 52 L 56 52 Z' fill='#ff6b6b'/>

  <!-- Front stem -->
  <rect x='68' y='35' width='6' height='36' rx='3' fill='#ff8888'/>

  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <rect x='58' y='31' width='26' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ffdd55'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='34' r='3.5' fill='#ffaa00'/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='44' r='5' fill='#aaffffee'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='44' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Seat -->
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='24' height='7' rx='3.5' fill='#aa44ff'/>
  <rect x='30' y='62' width='24' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#cc88ff'/>

  <!-- Cute eye on the deck front -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='72' r='1' fill='#222222'/>

  <!-- Little smile -->
  <path d='M 55 75 Q 58 77 61 75' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Speed lines -->
  <rect x='8' y='58' width='10' height='2' rx='1' fill='#88ddff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='5' y='64' width='14' height='2' rx='1' fill='#88ddff' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='10' y='70' width='8' height='2' rx='1' fill='#88ddff' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Rear reflector -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='66' r='3' fill='#ff4444'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#ffaaaa'/>
</svg>
